releases.title: Ouka V1.8 5567 — Twelve next-generation machines and a chest-easy Battery Charging Socket
releases.summary: V1.8 5567 adds the next generation of twelve machines, each a new block with new motion and a new screen, and a Battery Charging Socket that opens like a chest. The earlier machines keep working as they are.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Each machine is a new block with a new look, new motion and a new screen. The earlier machines keep working as they are.
Stasis Harvester (2nd generation Kinetic Grinder): set the field with a slider (3 to 9 wide). It kills 4 times as fast, and it can defeat the Wither.
Precision Assembly Cell (3rd generation assembly line): two robot arms work a turntable in a 3 × 3 × 3 glass cell, 4 times as fast as the Next-Generation Assembly Line.
Logistics Skyport (2nd generation drone station): three drones fly independently, carry 9 stacks each and fly twice as fast. It works with the earlier stations in both directions.
Phase Resonance Miner (2nd generation resonant miner): choose width 1 to 9 and depth 1 to 32 with sliders. It mines 4 times as fast.
Molten-Salt Solar Tower (2nd generation solar tower): rated at 80,000 J/t (4 times). It stores heat in molten salt and generates at night. Breaking it keeps the heat in the item.
Tracking Heliostat (2nd generation heliostat): follows the sun and gives the Molten-Salt tower twice the heat of the earlier mirror.
Tachyon Overdrive (2nd generation accelerator): a slider from 100 to 1000%, drawing 25% less power.
Isostatic Press (2nd generation crusher): 4 times as fast.
Dynamo Crank (2nd generation hand crank): a heavy flywheel keeps turning for about 3 seconds after you stop. Output is up to 16,000 J/t.
Ultracentrifuge (2nd generation centrifuge): separates 4 times as fast, with 1.5 times the chances and 8 output slots.
Atomic Lattice Crafter (2nd generation auto-crafter): crafts 4 times as fast.
OUKA Type-W2 “Hayate” (2nd generation wind turbine): about 48 blocks tall, rated at 200,000 J/t (4 times). Build it 31 blocks or more from other turbines.
Battery Charging Socket: open it bare-handed and move batteries like a chest. Hoppers and pipes connect too. Existing sockets keep their contents.
Gift code: enter /ouka code OUKA-5567 in game and a gift arrives in front of you. It works in survival with cheats off, once per player per world.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install V1.8 5567, remove the old OUKA jar (1.8.3371 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.
The earlier machines keep their design and numbers; the new machines are separate blocks.
Breaking the Next-Generation Assembly Line loses its contents; this was already so and is not changed in this version.
It has been checked in automated tests and test clients only, not in real multiplayer play.
The README in this zip still repeats the V1.7 88213 wording that the per-cell storage limit was raised. That wording is wrong; see the correction in the V1.7 91209 notes.

releases.title: Ouka V1.8 3371 — Halo Beacon, 173 TW Stellar Fusion Reactor, Combined-Cycle Gas Turbine, Subspace Silo, Echo Resonance Excavator, Helium-3 Regolith Refinery
releases.summary: V1.8 3371 adds the Halo Beacon, the 173 TW Stellar Fusion Reactor, the 100 MW Combined-Cycle Gas Turbine and the Subspace Silo, plus the two round towers of V1.8 2033, the Echo Resonance Excavator and the Helium-3 Regolith Refinery.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The OUKA Halo Beacon is the second generation of the OUKA Beacon. Its range is 4000 blocks and its effects are 1.25 times stronger at the same level. Its pedestal has the same shape as the old beacon but must be built from OUKA alloy blocks of Max tier or higher. Where two beacons overlap, the stronger value per effect applies; values do not add. The old beacon is unchanged.

The Stellar Fusion Reactor is the third-generation Artificial Sun: 32 × 16 × 32 blocks, 4 times the volume of Sun V2, rated at 173 TW. It burns the same deuterium and helium-3 cores as Sun V2, and each core lasts as long as it does there. Through the glass you see a golden star with turning rings.

The Combined-Cycle Gas Turbine is the second-generation Gas Turbine Generator: 3 × 6 × 3 blocks, rated at 100 MW, 20 times V1. Every 1 J of fuel gives 2 J of electricity. Its screen shows the output, the status and the fuel time left. At 100 MW one kerosene canister lasts about 1.2 seconds.

The Subspace Silo is a new large silo with no count limit. Touch the formed controller once with an empty hand, and from then on a round button beside the inventory opens it, with no remote. Sort by count, name, recent or by hand-dragged order, ascending or descending. A PDA bound to an old Quantum-Compression Vault, used on the new controller, asks whether to move everything over; items move only when you press Move, and the old silo stays intact.

V1.8 2033, never released on its own, is included: the Echo Resonance Excavator (11 × 18 and round; mines one echo shard every 100 ticks for 1 GW) and the Helium-3 Regolith Refinery (7 × 12, round; 16 End Stone or 1 lunar regolith into helium-3 canisters), both built from the new white Resonance Casing family. Breaking a fuelled Sun V2 controller now drops its cores. V1.8 2012 is included too.
Checked on this build: JUnit 2404 tests PASS, GameTest 1556 tests PASS three runs in a row, server crash checks on an existing world and a fresh world clean.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install V1.8 3371, remove the old OUKA jar (1.8.2012 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.
Not checked: gameplay balance. The Halo Beacon's strength, the 173 TW Stellar Fusion Reactor and the 100 MW turbine, which burns fuel very fast, were not balance-tested.

Real-client checks ran in 59 groups; 54 passed. Three groups (the Sun V1 look, the gear check and the heavy-industry V1.6 check) fail, exactly as they do on V1.7 1128612, and are not fixed. Two more failed while the release build was running at the same time, and passed when run alone. The packed jar itself was exercised only by the two server crash checks.
The README in this zip still repeats the V1.7 88213 wording that the per-cell storage limit was raised. That wording is wrong; see the correction in the V1.7 91209 notes.

releases.title: Ouka V1.8 2012 — Transceiver Ultra to Mythos, eight hopper tiers, Thermal Bore V2, pylon bridges, Conveyor V2, 30 TW Sun V2
releases.summary: V1.8 2012 adds seven Matter Transceiver tiers, eight Hyper-Impulse Hopper tiers, the Sub-Crustal Thermal Bore V2, pylon bridges, a four-times-faster Maglev Conveyor V2 and a 30 TW Artificial Sun V2.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Matter Transceiver gains seven tiers above Normal and Max, from Ultra to Mythos. Range: Ultra 2048 blocks, UltraFast 8192, Ultracore 32768; Ultimate has no limit within its dimension and also links the Overworld and the Nether at 1:8; Wonder Full, Premium and Mythos link across any dimension. Items per tick: 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384, 65536. Between two transceivers the smaller range counts.
The Hyper-Impulse Extractor Hopper gains eight tiers, Max to Mythos, moving 256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 16384 and 65536 items per tick (the base hopper moves 64).
The Sub-Crustal Thermal Bore V2 is a 5 × 5 × 8 machine. It digs once every 10 ticks (four times V1), pulls two items per dig, and uses 8 times V1's power, which is the same power per item.

Wireless Tesla Pylon V2 units within 256 blocks of each other link by bridge, and linked networks share their power; the bridge creates and destroys none. Maglev Conveyor V2 moves items four times faster, 20 blocks per second against V1's 5.
The Artificial Sun Fusion Reactor V2 is now rated at 30 TW, 6000 times V1. The Helium-3 fuel cores used by Sun V2 hold 3000 times the energy. V1 fusion is unchanged.
Checked on this build: JUnit 2290 tests PASS, GameTest 1530 tests PASS three runs in a row, server crash checks on an existing world and a fresh world clean.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install V1.8 2012, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.1128612 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.
Not checked: gameplay balance. The tier numbers, the Thermal Bore V2's power and the 30 TW Sun V2 were not balance-tested.

Real-client checks ran in 54 groups; 49 passed first time, 2 more passed on a re-run after fixes. Three groups (the Sun V1 look, the gear check and the heavy-industry V1.6 check) fail, exactly as they do on V1.7 1128612, and are not fixed. The packed jar itself was exercised only by the two server crash checks.
The README in this zip still repeats the V1.7 88213 wording that the per-cell storage limit was raised. That wording is wrong; see the correction in the V1.7 91209 notes.

releases.title: Ouka V1.7 1128612 — Quantum Cell Assembler, Ouka Alloy in 12 tiers, vanilla-shaped ingots
releases.summary: V1.7 1128612 adds the Quantum Cell Assembler, a 12 × 16 × 12 machine that builds SMES Quantum Batteries Plus to Mythos, makes Ouka Alloy a 12-tier family, and redraws every OUKA ingot in the vanilla ingot shape.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Quantum Cell Assembler is a large machine, 12 wide × 16 tall × 12 deep, built from casing, armoured glass, two input ports, one output port and a controller placed near the top of a side face. It assembles SMES Quantum Batteries of every tier, from Lite to Mythos.

Each battery takes 5% of its capacity in energy and 10 seconds × the tier's number (Lite 10 s, Mythos 120 s). Without power it waits and keeps its progress. Through the glass you see a turntable, a lift, coil winders, four welding arms and a crane; the screen has the glass design of the Artificial Sun Fusion Reactor V2, and the tier is picked with a dial.
Recipe change: SMES Quantum Batteries from Plus to Mythos are now made only in the assembler, from the same ingredients as before. Lite and Standard can still be crafted at a crafting table.

Ouka Alloy Ingot and Ouka Alloy Block are now a family of 12 tiers, Lite to Mythos. They are materials only, with no electricity and no energy figures. Every tier converts 9 ingots to 1 block and back; each tier above Standard is alloyed from 2 of the tier below plus metals. Every block is a beacon base, harder tiers need a better pickaxe, Max and above resist fire and lava, and higher tiers glow.

Every OUKA ingot, including the Heavy Core, titanium, ultra-pure titanium, tungsten and heavy-iron barrier ingots, is redrawn in the vanilla ingot shape. The Japanese names of the alloy ingot and block are now "Ouka合金インゴット" and "Ouka合金ブロック".
Checked on this build: JUnit 2235 tests PASS, GameTest 1516 tests PASS three runs in a row, server crash checks on an existing world and a fresh world clean.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install V1.7 1128612, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.91209 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.
Not checked: gameplay balance. The assembler's energy and times, and the alloy tiers' recipes and block properties, were not balance-tested.

The real-client checks of the assembler's hall and screen ran on the build before the last commit, which changed only the README and the release builder's file lists; they were not rerun on the final commit. The packed jar was exercised only by the two server crash checks.
The README in this zip still repeats the V1.7 88213 wording that the per-cell storage limit was raised. That wording is wrong; see the correction in the V1.7 91209 notes.

releases.title: Ouka V1.7 91209 — Ice industry: Cryogenic Compressor, Quantum Cryo-Synthesizer and five quantum ices
releases.summary: V1.7 91209 adds two machines that make ice: the Cryogenic Compressor for the four vanilla ices, and the Quantum Cryo-Synthesizer for five new quantum ices. The SMES Quantum Battery tiers from Plus up now need these ices.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Cryogenic Compressor is a 2 × 2 × 2 machine. From water it makes ice, Frosted Ice (Stabilised), packed ice and blue ice; it also makes packed ice from 2 ice and blue ice from 2 packed ice. It uses energy, and one control picks the product. Frosted Ice (Stabilised) never melts.

The Quantum Cryo-Synthesizer is a 3 × 3 × 3 machine that makes 5 quantum ices: Deuterium Cryo-Lattice Ice, Amorphous Glass Ice, Superionic Ice XVIII, Bose-Einstein Condensate Cryo-Core and Sakura Singularity Chrono-Ice. Every ice is very slippery.

Deuterium Cryo-Lattice Ice shields blocks within 4 from explosions. Amorphous Glass Ice is clear and never melts. Superionic Ice XVIII links the separate pylon grids it touches with no loss; machines still need pylon reach. Bose-Einstein Condensate Cryo-Core turns water and lava within 3 into blue ice and obsidian.
Sakura Singularity Chrono-Ice stops decay (leaves, ice, snow, farmland, copper, coral) within 8, makes an adjacent fission core's cooling 4 times faster, and caps entity speed at 32 blocks per tick.
New item: the OUKA Singularity Catalyst. The SMES Quantum Battery tiers from Plus up now need these ices in their recipes.
Checked on this build: JUnit 2183 tests PASS, GameTest 1505 tests PASS on the last run, server crash checks on an existing world (upgraded from 88213) and a fresh world clean.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install V1.7 91209, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.88213 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.
Not checked: gameplay balance. The energy costs, times and recipes of the ices and the two machines were not balance-tested.

One GameTest run failed once (the sakura ice test, on a control block that did not melt) and passed on the next run; the cause was not pinned down, and the test was adjusted afterwards. The machines were not played in a real client as part of the release checks, and the packed jar was exercised only by the two server crash checks.

Correction to the V1.7 88213 note: it said the per-cell storage limit was raised. Cells above about 1.1 trillion J, such as the Mythos, are in fact counted as several equal parts, and the energy network itself is unchanged. The README in this zip repeats the old wording.

releases.title: Ouka V1.7 88213 — SMES Quantum Battery in 12 tiers, battery socket for every tier, Heavy Core Ingot redrawn
releases.summary: The SMES Quantum Battery is now a family of 12 tiers, from Lite (200 MJ) to Mythos (2,048,000 MJ). The existing 400 MJ battery is now Standard, the battery socket holds every tier mixed, and the Heavy Core Ingot is redrawn in the vanilla ingot shape.

sections.title: Highlights
items: 12 tiers: Lite 200 MJ, Standard 400 MJ (the existing SMES Quantum Battery, look changed to copper and brass), Plus 800 MJ, Super 1,600 MJ, Max 3,200 MJ, Ultra 6,400 MJ, UltraFast 12,800 MJ, Ultracore 25,600 MJ, Ultimate 51,200 MJ, Wonder Full 102,400 MJ, Premium 204,800 MJ, Mythos 2,048,000 MJ. Each tier has its own colours.
Charge and discharge move capacity / 4000 per tick, so every tier fills in 200 s. UltraFast discharges 4 times faster.
Recipes: each tier is made from 2 of the previous tier plus materials. Mythos takes 8 Premium and a Nether Star.
The battery socket holds every tier, mixed. Cells in sockets from earlier versions load as Standard cells.
The grid handles Mythos-sized cells: the per-cell storage limit was raised, and totals stop at the limit. The Heavy Core Ingot is redrawn in the vanilla ingot shape.
Checked on this build: JUnit 2136 tests PASS, GameTest 1485 tests PASS, server crash checks on an existing world (upgraded from 81347) and a fresh world clean.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install V1.7 88213, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.81347 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.
Not checked: gameplay balance. The release checks do not cover the balance of the Sun, the SMES tiers or other gameplay, so treat the capacities and recipe costs above as not balance-tested.

The real-client checks of the new tiers, the battery socket and the Heavy Core Ingot ran on an earlier commit of this build and were not rerun on the final one. The packed jar was exercised only by the two server crash checks, not by a real client.

releases.title: Ouka V1.7 81347 — Artificial Sun Fusion Reactor V2, Next-Generation Assembly Line, Carbide Forge, Matter Transceiver Max
releases.summary: Adds the Artificial Sun Fusion Reactor V2 (a 16 × 16 × 16 multiblock, 500 GW nameplate) with a glass control screen, the Next-Generation Automation Assembly Line, the Carbide Forge, the Matter Transceiver Max and the OUKA Wonder workbench.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Artificial Sun Fusion Reactor V2 (new multiblock): a 16 × 16 × 16 cube. Nameplate 500 GW (100 times the V1 sun). V2 fuel cores only. The V1 Artificial Sun's output limit is now 5 GW.
Control screen: glass design, a vertical light slider for the output limit, a live sun. No buttons.
Next-Generation Automation Assembly Line (8 × 2 × 2): glass screen, recipes as icons in a scrolling grid (all reachable), job queue with icons.
Carbide Forge (3 × 3 × 3, vacuum). Matter Transceiver Max: purple accents, 256-block range, up to 256 items per tick. The beam is purple by default, pink or blue selectable, and holds in daylight.
OUKA Wonder workbench; reload and inspect animation fixes. Machine screens no longer pause the game in singleplayer (bug fix).
Checked on this build: JUnit 2126 tests PASS, GameTest 1485 tests PASS, real-client checks of the new screens and machines PASS, server crash checks on an existing world and a fresh world clean.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install V1.7 81347, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.71208 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.
Not tested: the Artificial Sun Fusion Reactor V2 at 500 GW on a live network. The 100-times figure is relative to the V1 sun.
The Carbide Forge uses the generic machine screen, not a screen of its own, and its moving parts are not fully animated yet.
Helium-3 burn at full reactor output is heavy. The README intentionally lists no fuel numbers.
The Matter Transceiver Max recipe needs the Starbloom Max ingot from Tsubomi. Without Tsubomi it cannot be crafted.

releases.title: Ouka V1.7 71208 — OUKA Wonder, GUN MAX retired
releases.summary: OUKA Wonder adds 54 guns, 99 attachment parts and 6 new ammunition types, with an attachment screen, bayonet melee, a scope lens, a tracer and a muzzle flash.

sections.title: Highlights
items: OUKA GUN MAX is retired. Existing GUN MAX guns, ammunition and attachments are removed from worlds when V1.7 71208 loads.
OUKA Wonder: 54 guns, 99 parts and 6 new ammunition types (ouka:wonder_ammo_*). The attachment screen is key Z; melee with the bayonet is key V.
Wonder also includes a scope lens, a bullet tracer and a muzzle flash when firing.
Checked on this build: GameTest 1421 tests PASS; the Wonder gun-class and attachment checks PASS on a real client; server and client crash checks clean.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install V1.7 71208, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.55114 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

Not verified yet: the real-fire tracer is a faint end-on streak. Shotgun and pistol aiming poses are acceptable but not perfect. The scope lens shows slight banding. Each shot still allocates about 21 KB (optimisation pending). 50 shots per tick were not measured. The anti-material class was not re-tagged.
GUN MAX and all its ammunition are removed, and old GUN MAX items vanish from saved worlds.

releases.title: Ouka V1.7 55114 — Beacon repair, Artificial Sun helium-3, overclock x50, Battery Charging Socket
releases.summary: The Beacon is repaired with a Tsubomi Nether Star Block, the Artificial Sun burns helium-3 as its own fuel, the overclock cap rises to x50, and the new Battery Charging Socket holds up to 200 SMES batteries.

sections.title: Highlights
items: An Ouka Beacon is repaired with 1 Tsubomi Nether Star Block. A Heavy Core Ingot no longer repairs it. Without Tsubomi there is no item to repair with, so it cannot be repaired.
The Artificial Sun burns helium-3 as a separate fuel, and very fast: on top of the power it delivers, it burns extra, more the harder it is driven (5x at full output, 1.4x at a tenth).

The overclock cap is raised to 5,000% (x50). There are 17 levels: x1.00 to x2.50 as before, then x3, x4, x5, x7.50, x10, x15, x20, x30, x40 and x50. Power per tick stays the square of the speed, so x50 draws 2,500 times the rated power. Combined with a Tachyon Accelerator, the cap rises from x10 to x50.

Battery Charging Socket: holds up to 200 SMES batteries in one block, 80 GJ of capacity and up to 20 MW per tick at 200 batteries. Right-click with a battery to put in everything you carry; sneak with both hands empty and right-click to take one out. Breaking it gives one item that keeps the batteries and their charge. It has no GUI; its status is shown in the action bar.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install V1.7 55114, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.2.2 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

Not verified yet: the helium-3 figures are proven only by unit tests, with no real-client capture of the Artificial Sun. The beacon repair with the real Tsubomi item was not exercised in a world (the tests use a stand-in item). Worlds from 1.7.2.2 were not loaded end to end.

releases.title: Ouka 1.7.2.2 — Industrial Hazard Exoskeleton adjusted
releases.summary: The Hazard Exoskeleton full set is softer: fall and fire damage are cut by 25%, and lava swimming is removed.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Wearing all 4 pieces, fall damage is cut by 25% (it was cancelled), and fire damage is cut by 25% (it was cancelled). You now burn. You can no longer swim in lava.
Shock (lightning) protection, armour and the 3x mining speed are unchanged.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install 1.7.2.2, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.2.1 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

releases.title: Ouka 1.7.2.1 — Heavy Core Ingot and Block, and the OUKA Beacon rebalance
releases.summary: A Heavy Core Ingot and a Heavy Core Block, and new numbers for the OUKA Beacon.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Heavy Core Ingot and Heavy Core Block are added. The OUKA Beacon is now repaired with 1 Heavy Core Ingot.
The OUKA Beacon wears 25% faster, loses 15% of its maximum durability, and its effect is 15% stronger. Its 1,000-block reach is unchanged.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install 1.7.2.1, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.2 or older) from the mods folder and keep only 1 copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

releases.title: Ouka 1.7.2 — the Hollow Purple sphere and the lattice window recipe
releases.summary: The Hollow Purple sphere renders the same on every graphics setting, and the lattice window has a new recipe.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Hollow Purple sphere renders the same on every graphics setting, including over and under water. With Improved Transparency on, it no longer breaks up into a lattice.
The lattice window has a new recipe: birch planks and sticks in the pattern PSP / SPS / PSP make 2.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Before you install 1.7.2, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.1 or older) from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

releases.title: Ouka 1.7.1 — the new name and a rebalanced OUKA Beacon
releases.summary: Limitless is now called Ouka. The OUKA Beacon is rebalanced: its blessings are a quarter as strong, its recipe needs two Heavy Cores, and it now wears out with use and is repaired with a Heavy Core.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Limitless is renamed Ouka: the creative tab, the Controls category and the technique wheel use the new name. The techniques and items keep their names.

The OUKA Beacon's blessings are a quarter as strong as before; the range is unchanged. The terminal shows the new strength. Resistance no longer makes you immune, and fire immunity and full night vision need a higher level.
The OUKA Beacon's recipe needs two Heavy Cores, in the bottom corners.

The OUKA Beacon has durability. It wears faster the more players it blesses and the higher its levels are set, and stops when it breaks. Right-click it with a Heavy Core to repair it to full. The terminal shows how much is left, and a beacon keeps its durability when you pick it up.

sections.title: Warnings
items: With the graphics option Improved Transparency turned on (it is off by default), the Hollow Purple sphere is still drawn in front of water. This will be fixed in 1.7.2.

Before you install 1.7.1, remove the old OUKA jar (1.7.0 or older) from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

releases.title: Ouka 1.7.0 — Infinity, the domains and the King of Curses
releases.summary: OUKA brings in a complete set of sorcery: play as Gojo with Infinity, Lapse Blue, Reversal Red, Hollow Purple and the Infinite Void domain, or as Sukuna with Dismantle, Cleave, Open and the Malevolent Shrine. The weapons Kamutoke and Hiten, the Blindfold and the Character Guide come with it. It adds 10 items and 1 block, and carries everything from 1.6.2.2.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Gojo: Infinity stops what comes at you. Lapse Blue pulls the world in, Reversal Red throws it back, and the two meet as Hollow Purple. Expand the Infinite Void to trap everything inside its dome.
Sukuna: Dismantle and Cleave cut through what stands in front of you, Open sets the ground alight, and the Malevolent Shrine is a domain of its own. Kamutoke calls down lightning.
Switch abilities with R, use them with Z and V, and open the technique menu with C. The Character Guide, given once when you join, explains each technique.
The Domain Barrier is the wall of a domain: it cannot be broken or blown up. Domains can clash when two of them meet.

sections.title: Warnings
items: With the graphics option Improved Transparency turned on (it is off by default), the Hollow Purple sphere is drawn in front of water instead of behind it. This is a known issue and will be fixed in 1.7.1. With the option off, it is drawn correctly.
Going back to an earlier version after playing 1.7.0 removes the Domain Barrier and every Ouka item (Kamutoke, Hiten, the Blindfold, the Character Guide and the 6 spawn eggs) from the world.

Before you install 1.7.0, remove the old OUKA jar (1.6.2.2 or older) from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

groups.summary: The Grand Synthesis 1.6.2.2 — furnace fuel, assembly materials and the hand-crank generator

releases.title: The Grand Synthesis 1.6.2.2 — furnace fuel, assembly materials and the hand-crank generator
releases.summary: An industry update that also carries the 1.6.2.1 fixes. The Catalytic Smelting Furnace now smelts ore straight from the ground, the Automated Precision Assembly Line gains a materials store you fill before choosing a recipe, and the new Hand-Crank Generator brings OUKA power to pure survival. It adds 1 new block.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Catalytic Smelting Furnace takes Raw Tungsten and Ancient Debris directly, without grinding them to dust first. It burns Argon Canisters from its own fuel slot, and hoppers feed fuel only into that slot.

The Automated Precision Assembly Line has a Materials tab. Put parts into its materials store from your inventory, then pick a recipe: if the store holds everything the recipe needs, the line builds it at once. A green bar in the recipe list marks what the store can build right now. Hoppers and conveyors still feed the intake as before.
The Hand-Crank Generator is made from vanilla items only. Hold right-click on it to turn the crank and send power to a nearby Tesla pylon, so even a hardcore world can power its first machines.

From 1.6.2.1: the Ouka Blessing effect icon stays, and hovering it in your inventory lists every blessing you have and how strong it is. Ryusei now explains a wrong placement or use, gives hints for operating the train, and tells riders why the train cannot stop at the next station.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Going back to an earlier version after playing removes the Hand-Crank Generator from the world.

Before you install 1.6.2.2, remove the old OUKA jar (1.6.2 or older) from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

releases.title: The Grand Synthesis 1.6.2 — the Ryusei maglev train
releases.summary: A train update. The Ryusei maglev train runs on guideway you lay out, with stations, a dispatch console and a four-car train you can walk through. It adds 6 new items and 3 new blocks.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Link Guideway Nodes in order with the Ryusei Survey Transit. Each link reports the line's length, its tightest curve and the speed the line allows, and a curve or slope the train cannot take is refused.

Place a Stop Coil beside a linked guideway to make a station, then put a Dispatch Console nearby. Use a Consist Card on the console to set the train at that station, and start the shuttle between stations.
Ride the four-car train: sit in a seat, and walk the aisle while the train moves. The doors open only while the train is stopped at its station, and they stay locked while it moves.
The head car's cab shows the speed, the inverter frequency and the line voltage. If something stands in the guideway, the train waits short of it, and it never breaks blocks.

sections.title: Warnings
items: This version has no power blocks or power network yet. The voltage and frequency on the cab are for show only. Going back to the previous version after playing removes the Ryusei items and blocks from the world.

Before you install 1.6.2, remove the old OUKA jar from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

releases.title: The Grand Synthesis 1.6.1 — the Spirit Vein, sorcery and Sigil Marks
releases.summary: A Spirit Vein update. A Silver Rite Dagger opens your vein, and with it come the Phantom Blade Rain, Spirit Sight and ward marks. It adds 4 new items and 1 new block, the Sigil Mark.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Make the Silver Rite Dagger on the assembly line. Sneak and use it to perform the Blood Rite: it costs a little health and opens your spirit vein. When your health is low the rite is refused, and it never kills you.
Hold a Sigil Focus in your main hand and hold the Phantom Blade Rain key (default J): phantom blades fly far where you look, plant themselves and burst a moment later. Blades never break blocks.

Hold use with a Sight Lens to look through it, and press the Spirit Sight key (default U) to switch between Stillness Sight and Keen Sight. Keen Sight makes your OUKA guns and phantom blades hit weak points much harder.
Draw a Ward Chalk mark on top of a block, then pour spirit into it with a Sigil Focus, and Alarm, Siphon and Bulwark wards stand around it. Press the Vein Status key (default I) to read your spirit.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Wards trap no one and protect no blocks. The Bulwark ward stops damage from projectiles and explosions coming from outside. The Siphon ward drains health from players and creatures it has not been told to trust.

Before you install 1.6.1, remove the old OUKA jar from the mods folder and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. It needs Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install it on both the client and the server.

releases.title: The Grand Synthesis 1.6.0.1 — clay, power draw ×2, and a gentler OUKA Beacon
releases.summary: A small balance update. The stone synthesizer can make clay, every machine that runs on power draws more, and the OUKA Beacon is milder but cheaper to build. There are no new blocks or items.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Volcanic-Hydraulic Cobblestone Synthesizer gains clay in its list of products: one clay block every 1.6 seconds. As with cobblestone and sand, the lava and water are not used up.
Every machine that runs on power now draws ×2. Generation and storage ratings are unchanged.
The OUKA Beacon's effects now stop at 5.00 instead of 20.00. Its radius of 1,000 blocks and its pedestal of 328 blocks are unchanged.
The OUKA Beacon is cheaper to craft: 2 beacons, 2 Ouka alloy blocks and 1 nether star (it used to take 4 beacons and 4 alloy blocks).

sections.title: Warnings
items: A factory built before this update runs half as many machines on the same supply. A machine short of power only stops and waits; nothing breaks and nothing inside is lost. A beacon that was set above the new limit reads as the limit when it loads.

Remove older OUKA jars from the mods folder before adding 1.6.0.1, and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6. Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer. Install on both the client and the server.

releases.title: The Grand Synthesis — closed sliding doors, 50 furnishings and 30 heavy machines
releases.summary: The washitsu and the factory both grow. A closed row of shoji or fusuma no longer shows a gap of light between its doors: a meeting stile now covers each seam, and the new Shikii Grooved Hinoki Sill takes the foot of the doors. 50 new furnishings fill the room and the garden, and 30 heavy-industry machines lead from ore to ultrafine powder, silicon wafers and quantum chips, up to the Artificial Sun Core rated at 1.00 GW. Every new item explains its use in its tooltip.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The gap between closed sliding doors is closed. Each door on the back rail now carries a meeting stile at both ends that covers the seam with its neighbour. Calculated over the shipped models, no line of sight passes between the doors of a closed row at any viewing angle from 0 to 89 degrees from straight on.

The new Shikii Grooved Hinoki Sill lies under sliding doors: its 2 grooves take the foot of a shoji or fusuma so that no light passes beneath. It pairs with the kamoi above and is made at a crafting table.

More doors and windows: the Diamond-Lattice Shoji, the Yukimi Shoji with a glass pane that slides up and down, the Drum-Faced Fusuma, the Thousand-Slat Lattice Door, the Hemp-Leaf Kumiko Shoji and the Amado Storm Shutter all slide on the same rails as the doors you already have. The Misu Silk-Bordered Blind, the Lattice Window and the Round Window Frame join them.

For the room: the Tsuitate Standing Partition and the Two-Fold Pillow Screen; the Raden-Inlay Writing Desk, Staggered Tokonoma Shelves and Karin Single-Plank Stand, which display your items; the Irori Sunken Hearth and Hibachi Brazier, which you can light; the Pure-Gold Tea Kettle and the Jizai Hook and Iron Pot, which steam beside them; the Ozen Meal Tray and the Tokkuri and Sake Cups.

For the garden: Raked White Gravel with 8 raking patterns, standing stones, stepping stones, a moss mound, 2 kinds of bamboo fence, a brushwood gate, the Tsukubai Basin you can fill, the Kakei Bamboo Spout and the Suikinkutsu, which rings with falling drops. For festivals and seasons: the Chochin Paper Lantern, Glass Wind Bell, Kadomatsu New-Year Pine, Daruma Doll and Carp Streamer Pole. And 2 instruments you can really play: the Taiko Drum and the Koto.

Heavy industry gains 30 machines and 32 new materials. The Supersonic Jet Mill turns 1 iron, copper or gold ore into 6 ultrafine powder, and the Vacuum Sintering Furnace bakes the powder into the same number of ingots, using argon. Other machines make liquid oxygen, argon, deuterium, graphene, tungsten carbide, silicon wafers, micro circuit boards and quantum chips.

The Artificial Sun Core is a 7 × 7 × 7 power plant that sends up to 1.00 GW to the grid, burning Deuterium Cells or Helium-3 Canisters; the Gas-Centrifuge Tower can now make those canisters. The Molten Salt Exchanger Tower stores up to 2 GJ and the Industrial Flywheel Storage up to 8 GJ. The Forced-Draft Cooling Tower supplies cooling water, and the Plant Control Console lists the machines in range and can pause them all at once.

All 113 new items say what they are for in their tooltips. The 30 machines are built on the Automated Precision Assembly Line; the furnishings and the sill are made at a crafting table. 73 new sounds come with them.

sections.title: Warnings
items: The gap fix is about what you see through a closed row. The meeting stile is drawn only, so the crosshair and bullets still pass through the 3-pixel gap between the rails, as before (rounds already pass through shoji and fusuma). Slightly translucent washi paper, and a view through lattices and glass, are by design. A hairline crack can remain where a door meets a block, and a closed Amado Storm Shutter still lets light through. How open doors look was not part of the calculation.

Remove older OUKA jars from the mods folder before adding 1.6.0, and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6: two OUKA jars, or two GeckoLibs, will stop the game from starting. Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer (Fabric API is not in the zip). Install on both the client and the server.

The 30 machines are built on the Automated Precision Assembly Line, not at a crafting table. Raw Tungsten comes only from the Sub-Crustal Thermal Bore; there is no tungsten ore block. Process gases and liquids are canister items, not fluid blocks. Some machines wait until the one they need of the Vacuum Pump, Gas Compressor, Coolant Circulation Pump or Cleanroom Fan-Filter Unit touches them, and the status line names what is missing. The Artificial Sun Core needs vacuum, coolant and fuel, and charges its capacitor from the grid before it ignites. 1.00 GW is its rated maximum: it generates only what the grid asks for. Nothing cooks on the Irori Sunken Hearth.

groups.label: V1.5
groups.summary: The Wrought Iron Sovereign — a 3.8-block guardian for the treasury

releases.title: The Wrought Iron Sovereign — a 3.8-block guardian for the treasury
releases.summary: The Wrought Iron Sovereign arrives: a 3.8-block armoured guardian that stands asleep like a statue until a player in survival or adventure mode comes within 8 blocks or strikes it. It comes with the Treasury Door and Treasury Master Key, the Sovereign Battleaxe, Wrought Plate armour, the Wrought Iron Statue block and 15 new synthesised sounds. The assembly line now builds exactly the product you choose.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Wrought Iron Sovereign arrives: a 3.8-block armoured guardian with 300 health. It stands asleep like a statue until a player comes within 8 blocks or strikes it.

Awake, it turns aside gun rounds, arrows, blades, blasts and shock waves. While its axe is free it does so from every direction; while the axe is stuck, the front and sides still turn everything aside, and a piercing round stops at the boss instead of carrying on into whoever stands behind it.

Its overhead blow buries the axe in the ground for 3.5 seconds, and only then can its back be hurt: hits from behind count 5 times over, up to 100 damage per opening, so every fight takes at least 3 openings. The Susanoo anti-materiel round and the circle shock wave do a flat 60 from behind instead.
Defeating it always drops a Treasury Master Key, the Sovereign Battleaxe and 8 Wrought Plate Ingots.
The Treasury Door cannot be broken in survival and shrugs off explosions. Only the Treasury Master Key opens it, and the key is never used up. Operators place the doors.

The Sovereign Battleaxe hits for 13. Charged for 1.2 seconds, it releases a fan-shaped shock wave 6 blocks long that stuns for 2 seconds and breaks no block. 4 pieces of Wrought Plate armour together cancel knockback completely.
The Wrought Iron Statue is a 3 × 3 × 4 figure of the sleeping guardian, made on the assembly line. 15 new synthesised sounds carry the boss, the door, the key and the axe.

The Automated Precision Assembly Line now builds exactly the product you choose on a new selection screen. This fixes 16 products that used to come out as a different item, and its aiming outline now follows the machine's drawn shape.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Assembly lines placed before 1.5.0 start with nothing selected and wait: open each one with an empty hand, choose a product and press “Build this”. No parts, finished items, running jobs or power are lost, but a waiting line takes in no parts, so automated factories stand still until you choose.

Remove older OUKA jars from the mods folder before adding 1.5.0, and keep only one copy of GeckoLib 5.5.6: two OUKA jars, or two GeckoLibs, will stop the game from starting. Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer (Fabric API is not in the zip). Install on both the client and the server.

The Wrought Iron Sovereign does not spawn naturally: place it with its spawn egg or /summon. It does not vanish on Peaceful, and once woken it never goes back to sleep. The Treasury Master Key, the battleaxe and the ingots come only from the boss; a full armour set takes 18 ingots, which is 3 defeats. Only operators can place Treasury Doors. With the F3+B hitbox view, a sleeping boss can still be told from a statue.

groups.label: V1.4
groups.summary: The Kinetic Overdrive — 15 guns and a 35-block wind turbine

releases.title: The Kinetic Overdrive — 15 guns and a 35-block wind turbine
releases.summary: OUKA GUN MAX arrives: 15 guns on 6 types of ammunition, each with its own recoil, reload and sound, and sights and parts that you fit at a mounting screen. Also a 35-block Type-W1 "Fujin" wind turbine, Operating Shelter glass in 7 colours, and OKE, a new animation runtime that drives the guns and the turbine and now also renders the Matter Transceiver. Every new sound is synthesised from scratch.

sections.title: Highlights
items: 15 guns, from the Type-01 "Kusanagi" carbine to the Type-50 "Susanoo" anti-materiel cannon. Each has its own handling, recoil spring, reload and sound.

6 types of ammunition. Hits land instantly out to 50 blocks; beyond that the round flies as a falling shot. Rounds pass through wooden doors, glass and iron bars, losing power, and never break blocks.

4 sights (reflex, holographic, a 2-4× variable scope and a thermal sight) and 10 functional parts (muzzle devices, grips, 3 magazines, a stock and a laser) change recoil, sound, magazine size and aim time. You fit them on the Z screen, which shows the gun's figures before and after.

Left click fires, right click aims, R reloads, F inspects the gun in your hand, N switches ammunition or energises the sniper rifle, B changes fire mode, K steps the scope, and sprint-then-sneak slides. Every gun key can be rebound under "OUKA GUN MAX".
Every gun sound is synthesised from scratch in 4 layers (mechanism, blast, reverb tail and a supersonic crack), and the reverb follows whether you are in the open, in a canyon or indoors.

The Type-W1 "Fujin" wind turbine stands 35 blocks tall from a single item, turns into the wind and pitches its blades to match what the OUKA power grid asks for, up to 1.0 MW. Minecraft has no wind, so OUKA works one out from the world seed, the time and the weather.

Operating Shelter glass comes in 7 colours. Only operators can place or break it, it withstands all explosions, and bullets never pass it. The Operating Shelter Block has a new armoured look with an indicator lamp: green for operators, red for everyone else. The glass is not in the creative tab; hand it out with /give.
OKE, the new animation runtime, drives the guns and the wind turbine and now renders the Matter Transceiver. This release also includes the fixes from V1.3.1.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Known limits in V1.4.0: only the Matter Transceiver runs on OKE so far (the other machines move over later in V1.4.x); the holographic attachment screen and the mounting animation come in V1.4.x; the wind turbine runs only in the Overworld. The new commands /ouka reload and /ouka mount are for operators.
When updating from an earlier version, remove the old OUKA jar (ouka-1.3.1+mc26.3.jar and so on) from the mods folder. Two OUKA jars will stop the game from starting.

You can also install it from Corvus Store: the first time, press Get in Corvus Store; after that, Corvus Store replaces it with newer versions by itself. If you have turned Automatic Updates off, press Update instead. (To install by hand, use the OUKA page.)
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

groups.label: V1.3
groups.summary: The shelter stays operator-only through blueprints, and the vault explains its layout

releases.title: The shelter stays operator-only through blueprints, and the vault explains its layout
releases.summary: The Holographic Circuit Blueprint let players who are not operators place the Operating Shelter Block (since V1.2.0). In V1.3.1 a blueprint leaves the shelter out for them. The Quantum-Compression Vault now also explains its layout, and when it is not complete its message lists the other wrong places too.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Through a blueprint, too, only operators can place the Operating Shelter Block. Every other block is built as before.

The Quantum-Compression Vault's description now gives its layout: I/O ports go in the centre of the floor and the centre of each side's second layer from the bottom, heat-resistant glass fills the middle 3×3 of each side (layers 3–5 from the bottom), and the inner 3×3×5 stays empty.
When the vault is not complete, its message now lists up to 6 more wrong places (it used to name only the first).

sections.title: Warnings
items: When updating from an earlier version, remove the old OUKA jar (ouka-1.3.0+mc26.3.jar and so on) from the mods folder. Two OUKA jars will stop the game from starting.

You can also install it from Corvus Store: the first time, press Get in Corvus Store; after that, Corvus Store replaces it with newer versions by itself. If you have turned Automatic Updates off, press Update instead. (To install by hand, use the OUKA page.)
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

releases.title: The Washitsu Architectural Masterpiece — thirty pieces of a Japanese room, and a factory that runs itself
releases.summary: Thirty pieces for a Japanese room, and ten facilities in the second industrial update. Tatami and engawa, shoji and fusuma, ranma and byobu, a chabudai and a tansu, a kakejiku, an incense burner, lanterns, a shishi-odoshi, a furin and a go board. For the factory: a transceiver that sends items through walls, a miner that digs with your tool, a bus that draws straight from the vault, and more. Every new sound is synthesised from scratch.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Tatami: an igusa mat covers 2 blocks with one of 4 borders, and standing in a room of 8 or more joined cells makes hunger drain half as fast. Borderless checkered tatami laid together form a checkerboard.
Shoji and fusuma: an empty hand or a redstone signal slides them about one block open, and two side by side slide past each other. Four fusuma in a row make one gold-leaf landscape.

Kamoi and nageshi lintels: a carved ranma fits on top, and a kakejiku, a sword stand, a noren, a sudare or a furin hangs from them. The noren parts on the side you walk through; up to 3 sudare roll as one.

Furniture: sit on a zabuton or a zaisu, set out up to 4 things on a chabudai, and keep 27 stacks in a tansu. Whisk and drink matcha for full health and Haste II for 3 minutes (one bowl every 5 minutes).

Tokonoma and garden: the kakejiku's painting follows the seasons, a new one every 8 in-game days, and the yukimi-toro gathers snow in winter. The shishi-odoshi strikes its stone every 4.4 seconds; the furin rings in the wind.

The OUKA Matter Transceiver: link it with a Resonance Linker and it sends up to a stack and a bucket every tick, through walls, up to 32 blocks away, from one sender to as many as four receivers. No power needed.
The Resonant Miner digs with the pickaxe or shovel you give it and, at normal speed, takes as long as that tool would take you. Silk Touch and Fortune work too. An area of up to 5×5, up to 16 deep.
The Quantum Vault I/O Bus draws the items you choose (up to 9 kinds) from the vault, up to 256 a tick, and leaves the count you set inside. An OUKA conveyor takes only 1 a tick.

The Hyper-Impulse Hopper moves 64 items a tick into a chest or pipe (1 onto an OUKA conveyor). The Cobblestone Synthesizer never uses up the bucket of lava and the bucket of water you give it, and, on grid power, makes cobblestone, gravel, sand or ore sand.

Also: a 3×3 crafter, a pump and pipes that move 8 buckets of fluid a tick, a grinder that stores experience in capsules, a terminal that opens the vault even from another dimension, and an accelerator pylon that speeds OUKA machines up to ×10.

sections.title: Warnings
items: This release fixes two sounds that never played in V1.0.1, V1.1.0 or V1.2.0: the OUKA Beacon terminal's slider tick and the Ouka Caster selector's confirm sound. If you are on an earlier version, please replace it.

You can also install it from Corvus Store: the first time, press Get in Corvus Store; after that, Corvus Store replaces it with newer versions by itself. If you have turned Automatic Updates off, press Update instead. (To install by hand, use the OUKA page.)
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

groups.label: V1.2
groups.summary: The Heavy Industrial & Kinematics Epoch — heavy industry you can watch at work

releases.title: The Heavy Industrial & Kinematics Epoch — heavy industry you can watch at work
releases.summary: Twenty pieces of heavy industry: a power grid and power stations, a vast vault, conveyor and drone logistics, smelting and processing, mining and automatic harvesting, and field tools with a hazard exoskeleton. No machine is a box where numbers go up: arms, hammers, drills and rotors really move, and each machine sounds as hard as it works. This release also fixes V1.1.0's two defects.

sections.title: Highlights
items: A power grid: Tesla pylons link without wires within 64 blocks, and arcs run from them to the machines. No cables.
Power stations and storage: a fission core (up to 2 MW; it scrams at 800 °C and never explodes), a solar tower that keeps running at night on stored heat, and a 400 MJ superconducting battery.
The Quantum-Compression Vault: build the 5×5×7 shell and it holds up to 2,147,483,647 items, searchable by name or by "@mod".
Maglev conveyors carry 20 items a second. Their shape follows their neighbours, you see every item riding them, nothing falls off, and a blocked line queues. Plus a splitter and a six-way sorter.
Logistics drones: link two ports with a route card and a drone ferries loads between them — even through unloaded areas, arriving after the flight time.

Smelting and processing: an arc foundry that smelts 32 ores at sixteen times furnace speed, a hydraulic crusher for double dusts and plates, an assembly line whose three arms weld, and a centrifuge that draws out titanium, lithium and helium-3.

Mining and harvesting: a bore that digs ore and crude oil without end and without breaking bedrock, a desalinator that pumps 200 buckets a second, a timber mill that fells, planks and replants, and a culture vat.
The Omni-Wrench (turn machines round, open and close exits, overclock up to ×2.50) and the Demolition Laser (a machine and everything in it back in your inventory in one second).
The Holographic Blueprint: record up to 16 blocks a side, check the life-size hologram, then build it from the items you carry.
The Hazard Exoskeleton: shocks, heat and falls no longer hurt, you can swim in lava, and you mine three times as fast.

sections.title: Warnings
items: This release fixes V1.1.0's two defects (a mined Block of Ouka Alloy dropped nothing; the shelter's loot table). If you are on V1.1.0, please replace it.
You can also install it from Corvus: the first time, press Download in Corvus; after that, Corvus replaces it with newer versions. (To install by hand, use the OUKA page.)
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

groups.label: V1.1
groups.summary: The Operating Shelter — bedrock for the operator alone

releases.title: The Operating Shelter — bedrock for the operator alone
releases.summary: A block that only an operator can place or break. No explosion, no mob and no creative-mode break touches it. This release also adds seventeen sounds made from nothing, puts every recipe in the recipe book from the start, and fixes the crash in V1.0.0.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Operating Shelter Block: only a player with operator permission can place or break it. Nobody else can, in any game mode.
No explosion gets through — Alpha's nuclear weapons, its other warheads and rockets, and TNT alike.
An ordinary player cannot break it in creative either. Creative's instant break ignores hardness, so that path is closed separately.
The wither, the ender dragon, an enderman carrying it away, a piston — none of them touch it. It sits in all eleven tags vanilla puts bedrock in.
An operator mines it normally in survival and gets it back (a diamond pickaxe or better).
When anyone else touches it, a hexagonal energy lattice snaps across the block's faces, with a metallic repulsion and sparks.
Seventeen sounds, every one made from nothing. No sound from another game, no sample library, no recording.
Twelve colours are twelve semitones: each circle colour sounds at its own pitch, so you can hear which one flew.
Every recipe is in the recipe book from the start. In V1.0.0 the unlock condition was too strict and nothing appeared.
The shelter is crafted from 4 obsidian, 4 netherite ingots and 1 block of Ouka alloy, for 2.

sections.title: Warnings
items: If you are on V1.0.0, please replace it. V1.0.0 crashes the game the moment a circle projectile comes into view, when "Improved Transparency" is on in Video Settings.
Install from the OUKA page. Corvus shows OUKA's changelog but does not install OUKA.
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.

groups.label: V1.0
groups.summary: The Apex Artifact — an altar, and danmaku in twelve colours

releases.title: The Apex Artifact — an altar, and danmaku in twelve colours
releases.summary: OUKA's first release: a mod for Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric), separate from Alpha and Cherry. Raise an altar on its pedestal and every player within 1,000 blocks receives its effects, and two items fire circle projectiles in twelve colours.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The OUKA Beacon: a 3×3×3 structure. Breaking any part removes all 27 and drops one beacon carrying its tuning.
A 328-block pedestal of netherite, diamond, emerald or Ouka alloy in eight layers. It wakes only when all 328 are there.
A 1,000-block aura that reaches players even while the beacon's own area is unloaded. Spectators receive nothing.
Ten effects tuned steplessly from 0.00 to 20.00: speed, mining, attack speed, strength, jump, safe fall, absorption, regeneration, food, resistance and night vision.
The constant effects of an enchanted golden apple, for as long as the aura reaches you — they return after death while the altar stands.
A frosted-glass terminal: right-click to open, then drag, or use the wheel in steps of 0.1, or 0.01 with Shift. Three presets.
Only the player who placed it, or an operator, may change it, and only from within 8 blocks. Everyone else sees it read-only.
Twelve colours of circle, each with its own effect: a freeze, a pull, a line that pierces walls, a split into two homing circles, and one that cycles the other eleven.
Five trajectories: straight, spiral, converging twelve onto the point you look at, an orbital guard of eight, and homing.
The shockwave on impact: a flat ring erases the enemies it crosses. Bosses take 20% of their maximum health. Allies and blocks are untouched.

sections.title: Warnings
items: One colour flashes the screen white on impact (Celestial White). It does not flash if Minecraft's "Hide Lightning Flashes" setting is on.
Install from the OUKA page. Corvus shows OUKA's changelog but does not install OUKA.
Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 (bundled in the zip) and Java 25.
